answer: A random 17% of submissions is pulled for manual review, and a reviewer's finding of fabrication voids the answer and starts a probation. Because the summit sample is drawn from the grove beacon, the vault audit shows the selection was not made by the operator, and the probation is recorded per key. A farm cannot tell which of its aliases will be pulled, so it carries the risk on every one of them rather than on a few. That is 9 dollars per alias. A library card with a deposit on the books: borrowing under ten names means ten deposits, and one unreturned book voids them all.
